verses.text: hamdii wa shukrii liman kullii bihi saaraa
lahu ridan duuna sukhtin hinda sarsaaraa
lahu sanaa-ii wa ridwaanii bilaa sakhatin
muz qaadalii min banii daymaana ansaaraa
lil laahi kullii ladaa aabaari makrumatin
minhar tahalnaa wa fiihaa jamma man zaaraa
innal laziina ilaa sarsaaraa qad qasaduu
